name: ZED X One GS, wide lens (2.2 mm)

sources.title: ZED X One GS Datasheet, Rev 2.3 (July 2026), Stereolabs
sources.covers: sensor (1/2.6" 2.3MP global shutter, array 1928 x 1208, 3 um pixels), output resolutions and frame rates, output formats, FOV, focal length, aperture and TV distortion per lens, dimensions, weight, power, IMU, synchronisation, interface

sources.title: ZED X One GS store page, Stereolabs
sources.covers: lens options with FOVs (wide 120 x 110 x 80, narrow 91 x 80 x 52 degrees D x H x V), hardware synchronisation and trigger through GMSL2

note: A monocular global-shutter GMSL2 camera with a BMI088 IMU (not modelled), for custom stereo pairs or surround vision. The FOV is the datasheet's "Max." figure; the native resolution is taken as the stated array size 1928 x 1208 (the FOV's image size is not said). Streams: 1920 x 1200 at 60 fps, 1920 x 1080 at 60 fps (cropping mode), 960 x 600 at 120 fps (binning mode), RAW10 over V4L2 (NV21 through Argus). The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. power_w 0.89 W (12 V, via GMSL2). size_mm read with the long side along the optical axis (the lens), an ASSUMPTION. Wide lens: 110 (H) x 80 (V) x 120 (D) degrees, focal length 2.2 mm, f/2.2, TV distortion "< 4.39 %"; 31 x 31 x 52.5 mm, 55 g. The store page gives the wide lens as 120 (D) x 110 (H) x 80 (V), agreeing.

sync.what: Datasheet: "Hardware synchronization for multiple connected cameras at frame-level within 15 microseconds"; store page: "Multi-camera hardware synchronization and trigger through GMSL2".
